component.name: Debtainium
component.summary: Install and update third-party .deb packages from GitHub Releases

description.p: Debtainium tracks third-party software that is distributed as Debian packages through GitHub Releases. It knows which repository publishes which package, checks for new releases, picks the .deb that matches your CPU architecture, verifies its SHA-256 digest, and installs it through polkit and apt.

ul.li: Track any GitHub repository that publishes .deb assets
Architecture-aware asset selection with optional per-app regex filters
SHA-256 verification before anything is installed
Automatic installation policy per application, plus Update All
Import and export of the tracked list as portable JSON
Background update checks through a systemd user timer
Full command-line interface for scripting and headless machines

description.p: Automatic installation policy, Update All, JSON import/export, token file support, and a tidier interface.

ul.li: Per-app auto-update switch, debtainium auto, and debtainium update --auto
Update All button and debtainium update --all
debtainium export / import with merge semantics
Release notes dialog, search filtering by status, main menu actions
XDG base-directory support, corrupt-config backups, cached version lookups

description.p: Fix installing a downloaded .deb by passing apt-get an absolute path.
First release: GitHub Release tracking, SHA-256 verification, GUI and CLI.
